title: Pickle Emoji: Copy & Paste 🫝, Final in Emoji 18.0
meta_description: Pickle (🫝, U+1FADD) is final in Emoji 18.0, published with Unicode 18.0 on September 16, 2026. Its codepoint was first reserved for Apple Core, then reassigned. As of September 25, 2026, no phone or computer shows it by default.
hero_tagline: A whole pickle (gherkin), distinct from cucumber and eggplant, final in Emoji 18.0 since September 16, 2026. As of September 25, 2026, no phone or computer shows it by default, but you can copy the codepoint now.
intro: Pickle (🫝, U+1FADD) is one of nine new emoji in Emoji 18.0, the emoji companion to Unicode 18.0, and both were published on September 16, 2026. Its codepoint has an unusual backstory: U+1FADD was originally reserved for a proposed "Apple Core" emoji in the Emoji 17.0 draft cycle; that proposal was deferred, and Unicode reassigned the freed slot to Pickle for the 18.0 cycle instead. It was a draft candidate until September 2026, and Unicode 18.0's emoji data now lists U+1FADD as "pickle", fully qualified. It depicts a whole pickle (a pickled gherkin), distinct from the existing Cucumber and Eggplant emoji it's most often joked about alongside: tech-press comment sections have floated everything from "that pickle is going to break the internet" to speculation it'll "take a lot of business from" Eggplant. Final does not mean it is on your keyboard yet. Google has published its design in the Noto Color Emoji font, but as of September 25, 2026, no operating system, keyboard, or system emoji font ships it, so expect a blank box or placeholder glyph until your platform adds Emoji 18.0 support.
sources: Unicode 18.0's emoji-test.txt data file lists U+1FADD as "pickle", a fully-qualified Emoji 18.0 emoji, and the Unicode Consortium's Unicode 18.0 announcement dates the release to September 16, 2026. Emojipedia's Unicode 18.0 report covers Google's Noto Color Emoji designs for the new emoji.
